writeup.headline: Applied Optoelectronics rates Hold as very strong revenue growth is offset by losses, dilution and a weak share-price trend.
writeup.thesis: AAOI scores 51, a Hold, sitting 14 points below the Buy band and 7 points above Sell. Growth scores a perfect 100, with latest-quarter revenue growth of 86.4% year on year, TTM revenue growth of 61.9%, and growth sped up by 35.1 pp from the previous quarter. That is pulled down by weak quality (28): gross margin is 28.9%, operating margin is -11.3%, and the diluted share count is up 43.7% year on year. The trend score of 25 reflects a price 63.1% below its 52-week high and 27.7% below its 200-day average, even though shares are up 170.5% from 12 months ago to 1 month ago. News risk scores 44 after price-target cuts from Needham and B. Riley and modest pre-planned insider sales; balance sheet and valuation were not scored, though P/S of 11.7x is high in absolute terms and more expensive than at 55 of the last 61 month-ends.
key_risks: Extreme customer concentration, with the top 10 customers at 99% of Q2 revenue.
Continued operating losses (operating margin of -11.3%) despite rapid sales growth.
Heavy dilution, with the diluted share count up 43.7% year on year.
Weak price trend: price 63.1% below its 52-week high and shares 55.3 pp behind SPY over the last 126 trading days.
Q3 results on Nov 5 could disappoint against the $255M–$290M revenue guide.
what_would_change: A move into profitability and better margins would lift the quality score and could close the 14-point gap to Buy.
A recovery in the share price toward its 50-day and 200-day averages would raise the trend score.
A Q3 miss, a guidance cut or slowing growth from the 61.9% TTM pace would push the score toward the Sell band, only 7 points away.
Further negative analyst actions or insider selling would weigh on the news-risk score.
